RoomSense — Technical documentation

BLE sensor gateway and touch panel of the house. It reads the room temperature sensors over Bluetooth Low Energy, publishes one reading per zone over MQTT for AcquaThermoNet, the heating controller in the boiler room, and shows the zones on a 600×1024 portrait touch panel: the temperatures, the setpoints (changed through AcquaThermoNet), the house mode, a screen saver with the outdoor weather.

This document describes version 3.0.0, to be installed together with AcquaThermoNet 3.0.0 (the reading topic changed). The same content, with rendered diagrams, is in RoomSense.html. Build: BUILD.md; tests: TESTING.md; deployment package: ../tools/package/README.md.

The MQTT contract with AcquaThermoNet is its document HA_Hmi_Relay/docs/SENSOR_GATEWAY_INTERFACE.md (the "interface" below, § numbers of that document): this one only says how RoomSense implements it.

Qt 5 / C++17ARM32 HMI 800x480MQTT + Home AssistantModbus RTU RS485met.no weatherTelegram botWatchdog

1. Overview

ApplicationRoomSense, Qt 5 Widgets, C++17 (formerly Thermonator: the repository folder keeps that name)
TargetUN65 HMI panel in the house (ARM32 Cortex-A9), 600×1024 portrait touch, custom init (no systemd), launched by JMLauncher
DevelopmentLinux x86_64, Qt 5.13.2 (Qt 5.15 also builds); generated readings instead of BLE
SensorsBLE thermometers with the atc1441 or pvvx custom firmware (service data 0x181A), one per zone
PeersAcquaThermoNet (heating controller, another panel in the boiler room) and Home Assistant, only through the MQTT broker
D-Bussession service org.roomsense.RoomSense, show / hide (optional)

Main features:

  • BLE passive scan, atc1441 and pvvx advertisements decoded, MAC checked inside the service data, implausible readings dropped (range, jumps not confirmed);
  • one reading per zone on RoomSense/<zone>/data every publish_interval_s (60–300 s), earlier on a 0.1 °C change; nothing for a sensor no longer heard, so that AcquaThermoNet detects it (the topic was RoomSense/apartment/<zone>/data up to RoomSense 1.0.0 and AcquaThermoNet 2.4.0: update the two applications together);
  • the house panel: one card per zone with temperature, humidity, battery, heating, sensor state and the setpoint −/+ (a command to AcquaThermoNet, shown as pending until it confirms);
  • house mode for the whole house (windows open, away, boost) and "all rooms" −/+ from a popup;
  • screen saver after a period without touches: clock, outdoor weather (met.no or wttr.in), a webcam image, alarms and rooms heating;
  • diagnostic page (long press on the clock): system, sensors, log;
  • hardware watchdog, single instance, clean shutdown on SIGTERM, a restart loop in the package.

2. System architecture

Two panels, far apart, each with its application in the foreground. They never talk directly: only through the MQTT broker.

  • AcquaThermoNet owns the setpoints and the house mode: RoomSense shows what it publishes (retained) and sends commands; it never keeps a setpoint of its own.
  • Home Assistant reads the same reading topics (current temperature of its climate entities) and changes the setpoints like the panel.
  • The weather is fetched by RoomSense itself, for its screen saver.

3. Software architecture

Two threads: the BLE reader (QThread, blocking HCI socket) and the main thread (Qt event loop: MQTT, GUI, timers, watchdog).

ClassFilesRole
main()main.cppsingle instance, signals, D-Bus, configuration, threads, shutdown
ConfigFileconfigfile.*setting.ini (created from setting.default.ini), all the sections
BleSensorsblesensors.*ARM only: HCI LE passive scan, reopen with backoff, heartbeat
FakeBleData, FakeScenariofakebledata.*, fakescenario.*desktop only: deterministic readings and events (RS_FAKE)
BleParsebleparse.*pure: HCI advertising reports, atc1441/pvvx decoding, MAC format
Mqttmqtt.*broker connection, plausibility filter, publish rate, AcquaThermoNet topics
ZoneControlzonecontrol.*no MQTT inside: setpoints and house mode as AcquaThermoNet publishes them, pending commands

The rules (filters, texts, colours, pending states) are in pure, unit-tested functions; widgets only display them. Colours are only in qss/default.qss (dynamic properties level, heat, setpoint, low, dropped, active).

4. Start and shutdown

Exit codes, as AcquaThermoNet: 0 stopped on purpose, 3 another instance runs (EXIT_ALREADY_RUNNING), anything else a crash. The package start.sh restarts on a crash only.

5. BLE sensors

5.1 Scan

  • ARM build (RS_BLE): hci1 if present, else hci0; LE passive scan, no duplicate filtering, socket filter on LE meta events.
  • Errors (open, scan parameters, read, socket closed) and 120 s without any advertisement close the device and open it again after 1, 2, 5, 10, then 30 s. The thread never exits; it beats a heartbeat during the waits too.
  • The package start.sh resets the Bluetooth module of the panel before the first start (GPIO 92, rsi_usb dev_oper_mode=13, hciconfig hci0 up), see tools/package/README.md.

5.2 Formats

Only service data of UUID 0x181A (Environmental Sensing) with the lengths of the two custom firmwares of the Xiaomi LYWSD03MMC-like thermometers:

FormatAD lengthMAC in the dataTemperatureHumidityBattery
atc144116big endianint16 BE, 0.1 °C%%, and mV BE
pvvx18little endianint16 LE, 0.01 °C (rounded to 0.1)0.01 % (rounded)mV LE, then %

The MAC inside the data must be the advertiser's; any other format, UUID, length or a malformed packet is ignored. A reading is passed on only for a MAC of [SENSORS].

5.3 Sensors and zones

[SENSORS]: one group per sensor with mac, name, zone (default: the name). One sensor per zone: a second sensor on the same zone is refused by the loader (logged) and not published. The zone must be a valid AcquaThermoNet zone name ([A-Za-z0-9_-], not list or mode), case sensitive.

6. MQTT

6.1 Connection

Broker[MQTT] broker_addr:broker_port (empty: localhost, 1883); user and password only when both are set
Client idRoomSense-<unique_id> (empty: the host name)
Keepalive30 s
AvailabilityRoomSense/status online / offline, retained; offline also as the Will
Reconnectafter 1, 2, 5, 10, then 30 s; a connection without CONNACK is dropped after 30 s
TLSnot yet (the broker has none today), §19

Clean session: the subscriptions are made again at every connection; the retained AcquaThermoNet state arrives at once.

6.2 Topics

TopicDir.PayloadQoSRetainInterface
RoomSense/statusoutonline / offline1yes
RoomSense/<zone>/dataoutreading JSON (6.3)1no§3–6
AcquaThermoNet/<zone>/set_tempoutplain number, e.g. 21.51no§7
AcquaThermoNet/mode/setoutnormal / window / away / boost1no§8
AcquaThermoNet/statusinonline / offline§7
AcquaThermoNet/+/state_tempinapplied setpoint§7
AcquaThermoNet/+/state_modeinheat / off§7
AcquaThermoNet/mode/statein{"mode":"window","remaining_s":1740}§8

6.3 Reading payload

{"temperature":20.4,"humidity":48,"battery":85,"battmv":2950,
 "data_time":1791320000,"mac":"A4:C1:38:00:00:01"}

temperature is a JSON number in °C; humidity, battery and battmv are omitted when unknown (0); data_time is the epoch of the advertisement.

6.4 Filters and rate

  • The first reading of a sensor, and the first one after 5 min without an accepted reading, has nothing to compare with: it waits for a confirming reading too (about 10 s more before the first publication; AcquaThermoNet tolerates 15 min of silence).
  • Dropping is always safe, publishing a wrong value is not: the controller only refuses a temperature outside −30…60 °C (a decoding error); anything within it switches the zone.
  • Nothing is buffered while disconnected and nothing is ever republished from a cache: a sensor not heard any more stops its zone topic, and AcquaThermoNet closes the zone after 15 min.
  • The dropped readings are counted per sensor (diagnostic page, "filtered").

7. Setpoints and house mode

ZoneControl holds the state of the zones as AcquaThermoNet publishes it and turns the presses on the panel into commands. It has no MQTT inside (Mqtt feeds it and publishes what it asks): it is unit tested alone.

7.1 Setpoints (interface §7)

  • The setpoint shown is the retained state_temp. A press shows the new value as pending (blue) at once; presses are collected for 1 s, then one set_temp per zone (rounded to 0.5, clamped to 5…25 as the controller does).
  • Pending until a state_temp arrives after the command (the controller republishes it after every command, also when unchanged or clamped), or for 5 s; then the confirmed value is shown again.
  • No command while AcquaThermoNet is not reachable: status not online, the broker disconnected, or no state_temp received for the zone. The last known value stays, grey.
  • All rooms (house popup): − aligns every zone to the lowest setpoint shown, or lowers them all by 0.5 if already aligned; + the same with the highest; one command per zone.

7.2 House mode (interface §8)

ModeEvery zoneEnds
window (windows open)min(own, 8 °C)30 min, or normal
awaymin(own, 15 °C)normal
boostmax(own, 25 °C)30 min, or normal

(Values of AcquaThermoNet [MODES], which runs the mode, the timer and the restore.) RoomSense sends mode/set at once and shows the request as pending until mode/state arrives (or 5 s); remaining_s is counted down locally (MonoClock). While a mode is active or pending, the zone −/+ are disabled; window is not offered during away.

8. Chrono thermostat

AcquaThermoNet runs a weekly program per zone (since 2.4.0) and publishes it (interface §9): the state on <zone>/chrono, the program on <zone>/chrono/profile; it accepts <zone>/chrono/set (on/off) and <zone>/chrono/profile/set (the whole program, or a reset). RoomSense keeps no program of its own: ZoneControl holds what was published.

  • Zone card: a chrono line next to the zone name: next change (22:30 → 17.0°), manual → 22:30, chrono paused (away), off, saving…; grey while the controller is offline, hidden without a chrono state. When AcquaThermoNet published a program the line is a button (with a chevron) that opens the chrono page of the zone.
  • Chrono page: today's program with the time now and the next change, the week, the weekday and holiday profiles, chrono on/off; after a change saved, refused or not confirmed.
  • Editor (Edit program): the profile on a large chart, slots as chips; the selected slot changed with big −/+ (time 15 min, setpoint 0.5, repeated while held), previous/next, split, delete; weekday or holiday, on/off, copy to holiday, same as weekday, reset to the controller's. Save sends the whole program once (QoS 1, not retained); Cancel drops the copy. A program changed elsewhere meanwhile is reported before it is overwritten.
  • saving… until chrono/profile arrives (5 s): the answer is compared with what was sent, sorted and rounded to 0.5; a different one means refused or rounded, and is shown.

9. User interface

Qt Widgets, 600×1024 portrait, dark, no designer forms. Pages in a QStackedWidget: main page, diagnostic page, screen saver.

9.1 Main page

  • Header: the clock (80 px) and the date; a long press (1 s) on the clock opens the diagnostic page (no hint, no PIN). In the middle the house button: the mode icon, its name and the time left (window, boost), "Sending…" while pending. On the right the controller and network state.
  • Offline banner "Heating controller not reachable: setpoints are read only" while AcquaThermoNet is not reachable (broker disconnected or status not online).
  • One card per zone (five fit without a scroll bar):
ItemContent
name, heatingHeating (orange) or Idle from state_mode; Off, no sensor (red) for a lost sensor (AcquaThermoNet closed the zone)
temperature56 px, --.-° for a sensor lost or not heard yet (never an old value)
setpoint −/+64×64 buttons; under the value setpoint (confirmed), sending… (blue, pending), last known (grey, controller offline), no setpoint (no state_temp yet), no zone; during a mode windows open, away (blue) or boost (orange)
humidity, batteryHum 48 %, Batt 85 %; Batt 15 % low in red below 20 %; -- when unknown
sensor stateupdated 2 min ago; after 5 min last reading … ago (amber); after 15 min NO SENSOR for … (red); no reading yet

9.2 House popup

Opened by the house button, a sheet from the bottom; closed by Close, a press outside or 10 s without presses. "All rooms" −/+ (§7.1) and the three modes Boost, Windows open, Away: the active one again goes back to normal; Windows open is disabled while away. Icons are own SVG drawings (icons/), rendered with QSvgRenderer (the panel needs libQt5Svg).

9.3 Diagnostic page

Back and three tabs:

  • System: MQTT broker and state, client id, heating controller, BLE adapter (hciN, scanning, error, retrying, simulated (desktop)), last advertisement, watchdog, uptime, log file and size, weather and its last error;
  • Sensors: per sensor name, MAC, RSSI, last reading, messages sent, readings dropped;
  • Log: the last 200 messages (info and above).

9.4 Screen saver

After [SCREENSAVER] idle_s without presses (an event filter on the whole application), from any page: clock (140 px), date, outdoor weather (hidden after 3 h without data), the webcam image (webcam_url, downloaded only while shown, 15 s timeout, the last good image kept), alarms and house mode, a flame chip per room heating. A press goes back to the main page and is consumed.

9.5 Show and hide

D-Bus session service org.roomsense.RoomSense, object /, interface org.roomsense.RoomSense.GuiInterface, methods show and hide. Without a session bus the gateway runs, only show/hide is missing.

10. Outdoor weather

As AcquaThermoNet (weather.cpp, ported), for the screen saver only:

ProviderNeedsNotes
metno (default)lat, lon (altitude, contact in the User-Agent)locationforecast/2.0/compact, symbol code → icons/wx-*.svg
wttrlocationone-line answer, no icon

Polled every poll_s (600 s, at least 60) all the time, with a quick retry after a failure; HTTPS through the OpenSSL 1.1 of the panel. Disabled without coordinates (metno) or location (wttr).

11. Logging

As AcquaThermoNet: categories rs.app, rs.config, rs.mqtt, rs.ble, rs.weather; info and above to stderr and to the [LOG] file (relative to setting.ini) with rotation at max_kb, keeping files old ones; debug to stderr only. Every BLE reading: QT_LOGGING_RULES="rs.ble.debug=true". The MQTT password is never logged. The last 200 messages are kept for the Log tab.

Typical lines:

I rs.app: RoomSense v3.0.0 (git 1a2b3c4, built 2026-10-07 18:30:00 UTC)
I rs.ble: Using hci0
I rs.ble: BLE scan started
I rs.mqtt: MQTT client id:  "RoomSense-house"
I rs.mqtt: Sensor salotto: jump 20.4 -> 28.4, waiting for confirmation
I rs.mqtt: Zone salotto: setpoint 21 sent to AcquaThermoNet
I rs.mqtt: House mode window sent to AcquaThermoNet
W rs.ble: No BLE advertisement for 120 s, restarting the scan

12. Reliability

RiskHandling
Event loop hanghardware watchdog (/dev/watchdog, root) refreshed by a timer of the main thread: no refresh, the panel reboots
BLE thread hangthe refresh also needs the BLE heartbeat younger than 30 s; a failing adapter is not a hang (the thread keeps retrying)
Crashthe package start.sh restart loop (2, 4, 8, 16, 20 s)
Clean stopSIGTERM/SIGINT: BLE stopped, RoomSense/status offline, disconnect, watchdog disarmed (magic close)
Two instancesabstract unix socket RoomSense: the second exits with 3; freed by the kernel on any exit, also SIGKILL
Broker downreconnect with backoff; no buffering; AcquaThermoNet closes the zones after 15 min without readings
Wrong readingsrange and jump filters (§6.4)
Controller downsetpoints and mode shown as last known, no commands
Wall clock jumpsages and timeouts on the monotonic clock (MonoClock)

15. Build

Summary; commands in BUILD.md.

  • qmake subdirs project RoomSense.pro: ThirdParty first (QtMqtt v5.13.2 static, always; libbluetooth and hciconfig from BlueZ 5.50, ARM only), then app/app.pro; CONFIG+=tests adds tests/.
  • Desktop: Qt 5.13.2, fake BLE. Panel: the Sdk/1.3.x SDK (Cortex-A7) with -mcpu=cortex-a9 (RS_ARM_CPU): the A9 has no hardware integer division.
  • Version from the latest git tag vX.Y.Z when qmake runs (version.pri), -<hash> after it, 0.0.0 without a tag. Release tags live on the public branch: builds of master show 0.0.0-<hash>.

16. Deployment package

Built after every ARM link: <build>/dist/RoomSense_Package_Arm32_<version>.zip and the debug binary next to it. Hooks, Bluetooth reset and update behaviour: tools/package/README.md.

17. Testing

  • Unit tests (tests/, QtTest, offscreen): 16 suites, no BLE, broker or display; the MQTT tests run an in-process broker (tests/fakebroker.h).
  • End to end (tools/e2e.sh): RoomSense and the real AcquaThermoNet through the AcquaThermoNet simulators, in an isolated network namespace.
  • Real broker (tools/broker_check.sh): publishes only on test zones the controller ignores.

What every test checks: TESTING.md.

18. Troubleshooting

SymptomCheck
A zone shows no reading yetthe MAC in [SENSORS]; the sensor firmware (atc1441 or pvvx, advertising "custom" format); BLE debug log rs.ble.debug=true; Sensors tab
BLE adapter: error, retryinghciconfig (adapter up?), the Bluetooth reset in syslog (tag RoomSense); the panel log
Readings shown but AcquaThermoNet sees nothingthe zone name (case, charset), Sensor …: invalid zone name or already used in the log; broker connected (System tab)
Many "dropped" in the Sensors taba sensor with jumps or out of range values: rs.mqtt log lines
−/+ disabledcontroller offline, broker disconnected, no state_temp yet for the zone, or a house mode active
Setpoint goes back after 5 sAcquaThermoNet did not confirm: its log and the broker
No weather[WEATHER] coordinates or location; Weather row of the System tab (last error); HTTPS needs the OpenSSL 1.1 of the panel
No webcam imagewebcam_url scheme and reachability; the JPEG image plugin of Qt on the panel

19. Known limitations and backlog

  • TLS to the broker: postponed until the broker has it; then as AcquaThermoNet (same [MQTT] keys), with clear logs for a wrong clock and a warning before the certificate expires.
  • Temperature chart: postponed.
  • UI and log texts are English only; tr() translation may come later.
  • To verify on the house panel: libQt5Svg, the JPEG plugin, HTTPS to met.no, the watchdog magic close, touch scrolling and sizes, the boot splash orientation (600×1024 portrait or 1024×600).
  • Qt 6 port postponed.
